create_tree_from_flat_list: create a binary tree from a flat list of node values using recursive indexing
create_tree_node: create a Tree node object with an initial value and empty children list
add_child_to_tree: add a child node to a Tree node and update the parent reference
get_tree_root: get the root node of a Tree by traversing parent references upward
compute_tree_size: compute the total number of nodes in a Tree including all descendants
